review: PASS detached guardian launcher and guardian leader-race fix
findings: Launcher restricts guardian and encoder names, validates a basename-only tag, requires a literal argument separator and creates a unique log with exclusive creation.
Popen uses an argv list and start_new_session=True, redirects full stdout/stderr to the owned log, and records PID/startticks plus exact source hashes.
Launch metadata explicitly does not imply a solver verdict or guardian completion.
Guardianv12 is encoder-allowlist-only; v13 fixes leader disappearance around stat read while retaining owned-group/starttick targeting and existing memory/escalation policy.
Launcher v2 only permits the corrected guardian v13.
scope: Infrastructure source review only. Solver model review is separate; no query launched by reviewer.
